# 5.1. Removing Spatial Correlation in Mods. w/ Raw Traits 
Here we will test spatial correlation at model residuals. To do so we will use spdep and SoDA package, the latter was used to transform decimal degree coordinates into cartesian. We followed the Appendix S2, sect. 4 of Bauman et al., (2018) to mensure Moran's I and correct spatial autocorrelation (if needed).

# Function 
This is a function to hurry up de analytical proceed.
```{r}
test_mem <- function(res, lw, nmodel = NULL) {
  # Select Moran’s Eigenvector Maps (MEMs) that explain spatial autocorrelation in model residuals
  mem <- mem.select(res, lw, method = "MIR", nperm = 999, p.adjust = T)

  # Store global Moran’s I value and its p-value
  sac <- data.frame(
    I = mem$global.test$obs,
    Pvalue = mem$global.test$pvalue
  ) %>%
    mutate(model = nmodel, .before = I) %>%
    `rownames<-`(NULL)

  # If spatial structure is detected (MEMs selected), return relevant info
  if (length(mem) > 1) {
    message('Check MEM data for eigenvectors...')
    mem_data <- list(
      sac = sac,
      selected.MEM = mem$MEM.select,
      summary = mem$summary
    )
    return(mem_data)
  } else {
    message('No MEM selected...')
    return(sac)  # Return only Moran's I info if no MEMs were selected
  }
}
```
# Packages
```{r}
# devtools::install_github("cran/SoDA") #install SoDA to deal with coords
library(sp)
require(spdep)
library(sf)
library(adespatial)
library(SoDA)
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)
```
# Load data
Transforming coords from latlong to UTM to enable usage of Euclidean distance.

```{r}
# Read coordinates and prepare environmental + community-weighted mean (CWM) trait data
coords <- read_xlsx("data/data_ferns.xlsx", sheet = "e_matrix")
x_ncor <- coords  # Keep a copy of the original coordinate data
coords <- subset(coords, select = c("Long", "Lat"))  # Select only the spatial coordinates
dim(coords)  # Check dimensions

# Load CWM trait values and models previously fit
cwm_values <- readRDS('data/cwm_values_raw.RDS')
nice_mods <- read_xlsx('outputs/cwm_raw_results.xlsx', sheet = 3)
```

# Creating a cartesian coordinates df
```{r}
# Combine coordinates and traits into one data frame
all_df <- coords %>%
  `colnames<-`(c("long", "lat")) %>%
  cbind.data.frame(cwm_values, x_ncor)

# Convert from lat/long (degrees) to Cartesian (meters) for Euclidean distance computation
df_xy <- SoDA::geoXY(
  latitude = coords$Lat,
  longitude = coords$Long,
  unit = 1000  # Convert units to kilometers
)
dist <- dist(df_xy)  # Euclidean distance between sites
```
 
# Spatial weighted matrix 
```{r}
# Build a neighborhood structure 
nb <- chooseCN(coordinates(df_xy), type = 4, plot.nb = FALSE)

# Compute distances between neighbors
distnb <- nbdists(nb, df_xy)

# Convert distances to similarity weights: inverse distance (normalized)
fdist <- lapply(distnb, function(x) 1 - x / max(dist(df_xy)))

# Convert neighborhood list into a spatial weights object
lw <- nb2listw(nb, style = 'B', glist = fdist, zero.policy = TRUE)
```

# Creating models and extracting resids.

Each block below fits a linear model with raw traits ~ environmental predictors. Then it extracts residuals and tests them for spatial autocorrelation using test_mem().

```{r}
# nice_mods

sac_diam <- lm(
  diam ~ ann_prec * prec_seas + plot_size + samp_size,
  data = all_df
) %>%
  residuals(.) %>%
  test_mem(., lw, nmodel = 'Rhizome diameter ~ AR * RS')

sac_rcomp <- lm(
  r_comp ~ nitrogen + plot_size + samp_size,
  data = all_df
) %>%
  residuals(.) %>%
  test_mem(., lw, nmodel = 'Compact Rhizome ~ N')

# Short Creeping Rhyzome
sac_rcr <- lm(
  r_cr ~
    ann_prec +
      plot_size +
      samp_size,
  data = all_df
) %>%
  residuals(.) %>%
  test_mem(., lw, nmodel = 'Short-Creeping Rhizome ~ Annual Rainfall')

# laminae dissection
sac_lmseg <- lm(
  lmseg ~ ann_prec + plot_size + samp_size,
  data = all_df
) %>%
  residuals(.) %>%
  test_mem(., lw, nmodel = 'Multipinnate ~ Annual Rainfall')

# Buds
sac_buds <- lm(
  buds ~ ann_prec + plot_size + samp_size,
  data = all_df
) %>%
  residuals(.) %>%
  test_mem(., lw, nmodel = 'Buds ~ Annual Rainfall')

# Indusia
sac_ind <- lm(
  ind ~ ann_prec + plot_size + samp_size,
  data = all_df
) %>%
  residuals(.) %>%
  test_mem(., lw, nmodel = 'Indusia ~ Annual Rainfall')

# Laminae dimorphism
sac_dim <- lm(
  ldim ~ ann_prec + prec_seas + plot_size + samp_size,
  data = all_df
) %>%
  residuals(.) %>%
  test_mem(., lw, nmodel = 'Frond Dimorphism ~ AR + PS')

# Spore chlorophyll
sac_spore <- lm(
  chl ~ prec_seas + ann_prec + plot_size + samp_size,
  data = all_df
) %>%
  residuals(.) %>%
  test_mem(
    .,
    lw,
    nmodel = 'Spore Chlorophyll ~ Rainfall Seasonallity + Annual Rainfall + MEM5 + MEM1'
  )
```

# Output data

```{r}
# Combine results from all models into a single data frame
cor_df <-
  rbind(
    sac_diam,
    sac_rcomp,
    sac_rcr,
    sac_lmseg,
    sac_buds,
    sac_ind,
    sac_dim,
    sac_spore$sac  # Note: spore includes selected MEMs
  )
cor_df  # Display Moran's I and p-values
```

# Saving data
```{r}
# Save table of Moran’s I statistics
write.xlsx(cor_df, "outputs/Moran_TRAW.xlsx", rowNames = T)

# Save updated CWM values and MEM-selected model for spore chlorophyll
saveRDS(cwm_values, file = "data/cwm_values_raw.RDS")
saveRDS(sac_spore, file = 'outputs/mem_chl_traw.RDS')
```
